description: pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs: ALLOWED_LEAF_EXTENSIONS does not include CRLDistributionPoints (2.5.29.31) or AuthorityInfoAccess (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.1). Every TLS leaf certificate issued by a public CA (Let's Encrypt, DigiCert, Sectigo, etc.) includes at least one of these non-critical extensions. verify_simple() returns Error::UnexpectedExtension for all such certs. The crate's module doc says it targets 'the overwhelming majority of TLS and code-signing chains' and 'the common happy-path case', which directly contradicts this behavior. Users who try verify_simple() on any public-CA cert will immediately hit this error. Either add these OIDs to the allowlist (without verifying their content, which is safe and consistent with the existing SAN handling), or change the doc to accurately describe the actual scope (private PKI only).
title: pkix-chain-simple rejects all real-world public-PKI TLS leaf certs
